en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a landscaped park with paths, dense shrubbery, and large trees. On the right stands a prominent statue or monument (Julius-Otto-Denkmal). Two women in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the paths. Residential-style buildings are visible in the background. Red printed German text runs along the bottom, including the place name and publisher information.
